8d8a7cc0-7718-4141-9640-a8bfdf3c0560/Eve.en: Huanxin and 'foster father' stepped into the Bamboo Hut. <NL>Inside, there was one hall and two inner rooms, covering an area of only a few zhang, <NL>but the windows were bright and the furnishings simple, offering a unique elegance... <NL><NL>'Haha! Good child, even if 'foster father' had built it himself, it might not have been so well done!' <NL>'Foster father' raised his hand to gently stroke Huanxin's head and brushed off the wood shavings stuck there..."
8d8a7cc0-7718-4141-9640-a8bfdf3c0560/Eve.cn: 焕心与“义父”步入竹庐，<NL>其内厅堂一间，内室两处，方圆虽不过数丈，<NL>但轩窗敞明、布置清简，别具雅趣……<NL><NL>“哈哈！好孩子，便是让‘义父’亲自修建，也未必能有这份妥帖！”<NL>“义父”抬手轻抚焕心头顶，顺势扫去其上沾着的木屑……

8d8a7cc0-7718-4141-9640-a8bfdf3c0560/Opt.en: Hehe, you are teasing me, aren't you, Father? I've only learned a tiny bit from you!
8d8a7cc0-7718-4141-9640-a8bfdf3c0560/Opt.cn: 嘻嘻，‘义父’诓骗心儿么，心儿只不过学了‘义父’的皮毛而已！
8d8a7cc0-7718-4141-9640-a8bfdf3c0560/Opt.ru: Хе-хе, ты дразнишь меня, не так ли, отец? Я научился у тебя совсем немногому!

cae71f1c-785b-498c-bcf2-8a06d562f04c/Eve.en: "'Foster father's' meager skill is nothing to speak of..." <NL><NL>"Foster father" waved his hand and said no more. <NL>Then "Foster father" took out a goat-hair brush from his bosom and slowly began to draw lines along the inside and outside of the Bamboo Hut. <NL>Huanxin followed behind "Foster father" and saw that "Foster father" drew one Dispositions Diagram each on the roof beam, the lintel, the left and right walls, and seven places behind the hut...
cae71f1c-785b-498c-bcf2-8a06d562f04c/Eve.cn: “‘义父’这点微末道行，却济得什么数……”<NL><NL>“义父”摆了摆手，便不再多言，<NL>随后“义父”从怀中取出一支羊毫，沿着竹庐里外缓缓勾画起来，<NL>焕心跟在“义父”身后，只见“义父”于屋梁、门楣、左右墙壁并屋后七处，<NL>各绘下一道符图……

b86fd6f8-ef4b-40a4-8179-c430c6a05403/Eve.en: Huanxin recognized at a glance that these were the 'Dispositions Diagram'. <NL>"'Foster father once said, 'Human disposition can be divided into five: Wit, Finesse, Composure, Fortitude, Valor; <NL>plus 'Harmony' representing the advantage of the land, and 'Luck' representing the timing of heaven—these make the 'Seven Dispositions'!'"
b86fd6f8-ef4b-40a4-8179-c430c6a05403/Eve.cn: 焕心一眼便看出这些是“七元符图”，<NL>“‘义父’曾经说过“人之性情，可分而为五：聪颖、细腻、冷静、坚毅、勇壮；<NL>加上代表地利之‘合道’；代表天时之‘福缘’，乃成‘七元’！”

b86fd6f8-ef4b-40a4-8179-c430c6a05403/Opt.en: But what purpose do the Dispositions Diagrams serve?
b86fd6f8-ef4b-40a4-8179-c430c6a05403/Opt.cn: ‘义父’绘制七元符图，却不知作何妙用……
b86fd6f8-ef4b-40a4-8179-c430c6a05403/Opt.ru: Но какой цели служат диаграммы диспозиций?

1709c8cd-dbd2-4451-9b18-8a9e33e4726a/Eve.en: "'Foster father' only mentioned it once, and you remembered... <NL>The Dispositions are the human heart and human nature. This 'Dispositions Diagram' serves to reveal and guide the 'Seven Dispositions' of a person... <NL>Our Enemy feeds on the human heart. Only this method can conceal us, preventing the Enemy from detecting our location. <NL><NL>Ah, the formation is critical. These matters, 'foster father' will slowly tell you later..."
1709c8cd-dbd2-4451-9b18-8a9e33e4726a/Eve.cn: “‘义父’只提起那么一次，你便记住啦……<NL>七元即是人心、人性，这‘七元符图’，对人之‘七元’则有昭示、启引之用……<NL>你我仇敌以人心为食，唯有此法可以遮蔽，令仇敌无法察觉你我所在，<NL><NL>欸，布阵紧要，这些事情，‘义父’以后慢慢说给你听……”

1709c8cd-dbd2-4451-9b18-8a9e33e4726a/Opt.en: Yes, Father. I will take them to heart...
1709c8cd-dbd2-4451-9b18-8a9e33e4726a/Opt.ru: Да, отец. Я приму их близко к сердцу...

0bcbae22-f70b-471e-b246-e8865677c26f/Eve.en: Huanxin followed 'foster father' to the Open Ground in front of the Bamboo Hut. <NL>'Foster father' sat cross-legged, pressed his right palm lightly over his Dantian, and slowly pushed his left palm forward, evidently channeling inner force. <NL>In a moment, white steam rose from 'foster father's' head, and fine sweat appeared on his forehead... <NL><NL>"'Foster father once said that when Qi is being discharged, it is most dangerous; the slightest carelessness can be fatal." <NL>Thinking of this, Huanxin immediately held her breath and concentrated, not daring to breathe loudly, afraid of disturbing 'foster father'..."
0bcbae22-f70b-471e-b246-e8865677c26f/Eve.cn: 焕心随“义父”来到竹庐前的空地，<NL>“义父”盘膝坐下，右掌虚按丹田，左掌缓缓前推，显是在运使内劲，<NL>不过片刻，只见“义父”头顶白气蒸腾，额角已然渗出细汗……<NL><NL>“‘义父’曾说过，内力倾泻之时最为凶险，稍有不慎，便有性命之虞。”<NL>焕心想到此处，立时屏息凝神，便连大气也不敢喘，生怕搅扰了“义父”……

0bcbae22-f70b-471e-b246-e8865677c26f/Opt.en: I must focus intently and guard Foster Father!
0bcbae22-f70b-471e-b246-e8865677c26f/Opt.cn: 我须得目注心凝，为‘义父’护法！
0bcbae22-f70b-471e-b246-e8865677c26f/Opt.ru: Я должен сосредоточиться и охранять Приемного отца!

26cbbcc3-3b38-428c-ad8b-45fe459fea57/Eve.en: As Huanxin was pondering, she suddenly smelled a foul, rancid odor... <NL><NL>Turning to look, she couldn't help but gasp— <NL>A giant serpent was approaching with its head raised. Its body was as thick as a beam, scales like tiles. <NL>Its crimson forked tongue flickered, hissing, with dark shapes behind it as more serpents slithered out, <NL>surrounding the Bamboo Hut like an iron barrel!
26cbbcc3-3b38-428c-ad8b-45fe459fea57/Eve.cn: 焕心正思量间，突然闻到一股腥臭之气……<NL><NL>当下转身看去，不由得惊呼出声——<NL>但见一条两丈余长的巨蟒昂首迫近，身若覆瓦，粗似梁柱，<NL>猩红长信吞吐间，咝咝作响，身后黑影幢幢，另有数条大蟒蜿蜒而出，<NL>已将竹庐四下围得铁桶相似！

26cbbcc3-3b38-428c-ad8b-45fe459fea57/Opt.en: Such... such giant serpents in the valley! No! I must not let them disturb Foster Father!
26cbbcc3-3b38-428c-ad8b-45fe459fea57/Opt.cn: 谷中……竟有如此巨蟒，不好！断不可让这些长虫惊扰了‘义父’！
26cbbcc3-3b38-428c-ad8b-45fe459fea57/Opt.ru: Такой... такие гигантские змеи в долине! Нет! Я не должен позволить им беспокоить приемного отца!
